name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd), HER2-positive second line
cyclesNote: Trastuzumab deruxtecan for HER2-positive metastatic gastric / esophagogastric adenocarcinoma progressing after a trastuzumab-containing regimen (DESTINY-Gastric population); continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: StewardMD ONCOTREE draft protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Indicated for HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH-amplified) disease after prior trastuzumab.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is moderately to highly emetogenic; give multi-agent antiemetic prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: Single-agent HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate; no cytotoxic chemotherapy backbone.
Educate patient to report new or worsening cough, dyspnea, or fever (interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis).
Monitor for nausea, myelosuppression, and left ventricular dysfunction.
monitoring: chest imaging and symptom review for interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis before each cycle
clinical assessment for nausea and fatigue

doseModificationRules.condition: any grade of interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt for suspected ILD, start corticosteroids, and permanently discontinue for grade 2 or higher ILD; physician decides.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
drugs.notes: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 6.4 mg/kg IV on day 1 every 21 days for HER2-positive metastatic gastric / esophagogastric adenocarcinoma after prior trastuzumab. Vigilant monitoring for interstitial lung disease. StewardMD standard-of-care wording; physician decides and the dose engine computes the patient dose.
